g.text: Cue — Authentication and Session Flow (FR-01, NFR-01)
Unauthorized access and failure branches included
[API] Validate email format and password rule
Open a protected page / call API
Box colour = layer that performs the step:
blue = SPA (browser), green = API, amber = PostgreSQL.
Unauthorized access: no or invalid session → 401 → S1; authenticated but foreign resource → 404.
Only the SHA-256 of the session token is stored. Rate limiting is in-process (single API instance assumed).
